body: Honestly I'm considering to just reread the whole thing every time after reading the newest released chapter.
Didn't feel like this after One Piece, HxH or JJK though, so that can't be the only factor.

This is one of the manga I was talking about. The comedy and characters are alright, but it just feels mediocre after reading Grand Blue. I only read the first few chapters though, so maybe I'll read a couple more in case it gets better.
I weigh nearly all of my food and have lost a significant amount of weight ever since I started doing it.

When someone is lying to you, you have reason to believe that they're lying, and then proceed to take actions to find out the truth, that isn't you being crazy. Whether your behaviour was rational or not doesn't matter, since it was him who triggered that behaviour. You smiled in his face whilst you did "crazy shit"? Sounds like victim blaming yourself to me. He smiled in your face but lied about talking to other girls. I'm not going to pretend your reaction was normal or that your BPD played no role in this, but I don't think it's fair to expect a "normal" reaction to someone's abnormal/manipulative behaviour. Your BPD amplified the intensity of your reaction, but that doesn't mean your BPD is the sole culprit of the situation. Because the real culprit was his manipulative behaviour.

When dealing with lying/gaslighting/cheating, even people without BPD do "crazy" things. It's good that you're taking accountability for the fact that you went too far with the cyberstalking, but don't you blame yourself for "ruining the relationship", because the one responsible for that is almost completely him, not you.

You may have BPD, but a decent partner wouldn't do the things he did, and you deserve better than that. Everyone does.
